FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Kamau: Salut, Amina ! Ça va ? Amina: Oui, ça va bien, merci. Question: How does Amina answer? (1 mark)
   A. She says goodbye.
   B. She asks for a present.
   C. She says she is well.
   D. She gives her age.

2. What does 'Et toi ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. Hi, Kamau!
   C. And you?
   D. Good evening, Madam!

3. Read: Je m'appelle Amina. J'ai un frère et une sœur. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. Question: Who is Njeri? (1 mark)
   A. Amina's sister
   B. Amina's friend
   C. Amina's mother
   D. Amina's grandmother

4. What does 'C'est ma sœur.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my brother.
   B. This is my father.
   C. My mother is called Grace.
   D. This is my sister.

5. Read: Voici ma maison. Dans la cuisine, il y a une table et deux chaises. Le frigo est près de la porte. Mon lit est sous la fenêtre. Question: Where is the bed? (1 mark)
   A. in the kitchen
   B. under the window
   C. near the fridge
   D. behind the door

6. What does 'Voici ma maison.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my house.
   B. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   C. The rug is in front of the sofa.
   D. The ball is behind the door.

7. Which day comes before mercredi? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. jeudi
   C. vendredi
   D. mardi

8. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: What does he do on Saturday? (1 mark)
   A. He goes to school.
   B. He plays football.
   C. He goes to church.
   D. He sings.

9. What does 'Je chante et je danse.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. When is your birthday?
   B. I am nine years old.
   C. I sing and I dance.
   D. Thank you very much!

10. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: Whose birthday is it? (1 mark)
   A. Kamau's
   B. Amina's
   C. Njeri's
   D. the teacher's

11. What does 'Bon anniversaire !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy birthday!
   B. My birthday is on 30 June.
   C. I sing and I dance.
   D. There is a cake and there are balloons.

12. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: How many candles are there? (1 mark)
   A. two
   B. ten
   C. five
   D. twelve

13. What does 'Je bois un jus.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink a juice.
   B. I like the mango.
   C. They are mangoes.
   D. I eat a mango.

14. Fill in: Je ______ un jus. (I drink) (1 mark)
   A. aime
   B. bois
   C. suis
   D. mange

15. What does 'Touche ton nez !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have ten fingers.
   B. Touch your nose!
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. I have two feet.

16. What does 'Elle a les cheveux noirs.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She has long hair.
   B. Touch your nose!
   C. She has black hair.
   D. I have two hands.

17. Which little word goes with 'nuage' (the cloud)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. la
   D. le

18. What does 'Demain, il fait beau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is nice.
   B. There is a storm.
   C. It is snowing.
   D. Tomorrow the weather is nice.

19. Fill in: La porte est ______ la fenêtre. (next to) (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. dans
   C. entre
   D. à côté de

20. What does 'Le frigo est dans la cuisine.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is behind the door.
   B. Turn left.
   C. Where is the key?
   D. The fridge is in the kitchen.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write three sentences in French about what you do on different days. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into English: 'Où est la clé ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Translate into English: 'Le chat est derrière la porte.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Translate into English: 'Mets le livre sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Sort into friendly and harsh weather: le soleil, l'orage, le beau temps, le vent très fort. (4 marks) (4 marks)

26. Translate into English: 'Il y a du vent.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Write three sentences in French to say where objects are in a room. Use three different position words. (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux mains.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Explain how you read the word salut aloud. Say which letter is silent. (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Translate into English: 'J'ai un frère et une sœur.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — She says she is well.
   Ça va bien, merci means I am well, thank you.

2. C — And you?
   Et toi ? means And you?

3. A — Amina's sister
   Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.

4. D — This is my sister.
   C'est ma sœur. means This is my sister.

5. B — under the window
   Mon lit est sous la fenêtre.

6. A — Here is my house.
   Voici ma maison. means Here is my house.

7. D — mardi
   Tuesday comes before Wednesday.

8. B — He plays football.
   Le samedi, je joue au football.

9. C — I sing and I dance.
   Je chante et je danse. means I sing and I dance.

10. B — Amina's
   C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina.

11. A — Happy birthday!
   Bon anniversaire ! means Happy birthday!

12. B — ten
   Dix bougies means ten candles.

13. A — I drink a juice.
   Je bois un jus. means I drink a juice.

14. B — bois
   Je bois means I drink.

15. B — Touch your nose!
   Touche ton nez ! means Touch your nose!

16. C — She has black hair.
   Elle a les cheveux noirs. means She has black hair.

17. D — le
   nuage is masculine, so we say le nuage.

18. D — Tomorrow the weather is nice.
   Demain, il fait beau. means Tomorrow the weather is nice.

19. D — à côté de
   À côté de means next to.

20. D — The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Le frigo est dans la cuisine. means The fridge is in the kitchen.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le lundi, je vais à l'école. Le samedi, je joue. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Where is the key?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: The cat is behind the door.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Put the book on the table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Friendly: le soleil, le beau temps. Harsh: l'orage, le vent très fort.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is windy.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le livre est sur la table. Le chat est sous la chaise. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two hands.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: You read sa-LÜ. The t at the end is silent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the respelling, 1 mark for the silent t, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: I have a brother and a sister.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.
